# Official Sherpa business case

## Business problem

EA is a bottleneck: too many technology decisions depend on scarce architects, causing slow cycles, inconsistent standards, and limited scalability.

## Official intent and intended outcome

Project Beacon turns EA expertise into governed self-service so routine work no longer requires direct architect involvement.
